name: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
objectiveText: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains . Gerenzo's Mechanical Arm  ( 1 )

comments.body: In order to get up to the top of the waterwheel you need to go over to the far east side of the lake. You'll find a path there that leads up into the cliffs and to the top of the wheel.

The route up the mountain is up the east side.  Follow the lake and it takes you to a path leading up to the water wheel area.  Make sure you kill Gerenzo without him falling off when he makes a run for it at low health.  ;)

I don't know if anyone's mentioned it yet, but here's a trick.

When you get to gerenzo focus everything you have on him, kill him, loot him immediately and then book it for the edge and jump off into the lake below.

Not only could it save your life, but its fun too. :)

The trail is up from the right side of the lake.

Only worth 2200 xp.
replies: it depends on what lvl you are, depends on how much exp u get, the lower the lvl, the more exp u get :D

um the xp is the same at any lvl that the quest is green, yellow, orange or red, but not at grey (your too high a lvl at that point).  Some peeps say that u also get less xp at green just before the lvl it turns grey, but im not sure about this.

comments.body: 64, 39 Cragpool Lake (In the Water Wheel).

If you do him methodically, he's cake, no matter where he spawns.  Did him with my 23 shaman on the far east platform. 

Just kill down to him, target the add.  For myself, dropped earthbind, searing, and healing wave.  Kill the add and run away.  The little mech that spawned despawns when you're out of combat.  Now you have Gerenzo all by his lonesome.  Rinse and repeat.

There is a roamer that I had noticed before starting, but I figured someone would be dead before he came back around.  Wrong. He made it to me before the deed was done, so i thought...what the heck, 1/3rd health, just jump in the water.  Loot up and jump off.  That leads me to my final suggestion, jump off the east side of the platform.  I had about 300 of my 950ish hps and the fall was for 923.  You do the math. 

Good luck to all you hordies doing this.  To you alliance types, jump off the north side. =)

if u looking for a way to come up, took me ages, look for the trail at loc 73,41. u have to run behind the mountain.

Happy Hunting!
Staika
replies: The trail is at 69,40 and it heads north

comments.body:
This is a fairly simple quest, if you go to the lake  there is a trail up the top of the lake. Once you get to the platform he spawns not too far away.

He is level 27.

I've tried to solo this a couple of times and finally managed it with ease as a lvl 30 hunter. It could have been done at an earlier lvl but it depends on which platform Gerenzo spawns. I had him spawning on three different platforms and most of the times he spawned on the last. This is most difficult because there is another mob guarding him (as on all other platforms), but the real problem is that you can't attack him from a distance before you actually set a foot on that platform. However, this is causing his guard to attack you and the guard spawns his little helper and you have to deal with Gerenzo as well. Three of them are a rather tough fight and I never managed to kill Gerenzo and grab his mechanical arm before I died.
On my last and finally successful try I had him on the platform with the big machinery and since I was able to attack him from above, it was an easy task because his guard doesn't follow him when you attack Gerenzo directly. 
So the point is, have a go at Gerenzo from a distance when you can and don't bother taking out his guard first. Gerenzo attacks together with his guard, but his guard doesn't join him when he is under attack.

All you druids out there - this guy is a piece of cake at 22.

Go up in cat form.  Single pull and solo the normal mobs on the platforms, they're all lev 20 / 21.  Make sure you apply a RIP after the third or fourth Claw, this stops 'em from pulling adds onto you.

Watch out for the Engineer, as he pulls a mechanical helper out of nowhere.

The main guy is a single pull.  Pull down a level to you (This is how he's a single!) with Faerie Fire whist in humanoid form, change to CAT form right away (You're thinking BEAR, right?  Well no, cat form has the DPS, bear doesn't), Build up 5 combo points with Claw, apply a rip, change back to human, cast a Healing touch, followed by a rejuvenation, then it's back into cat mode to apply more DPS... 

Make sure you try to keep a 3 combo point or more rip on the little sod, so if he does run away (And he will at 10%ish) he doesn't make it too far.

Needless to say you'll have cleared all the other mobs on the lower platforms, right? ;)

It's amazing you can do this at level 22 solo, the mob is level 27, five levels above you!  Technically you shouldn't be able to lay a finger on his arse, yet the power of the druid shows through again!
